terra.problem: Saying the others started it adds a sequence the passage does not give. Paul says many are boasting and that he too will boast.
The claims about God's promises to Abraham and Hebrew ancestry go beyond this passage and need Scripture references.
Identifying Moses as Israel's leader adds a Bible fact from outside this passage without a reference.
“Paul keeps going” suggests he continued traveling after the shipwrecks, but the passage does not establish that sequence.
“I think it's because it's true” supplies a reason Paul spoke that the text does not give. His reasons must not be invented, even as a guess.
The comparison suggests God says Paul's account is true. Paul says God knows he is not lying, not that God speaks an affirmation.
